newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SHARES EXTEND GAINS, EKRANAS CORRECTION SEEN.
newsitem.headline: SHARES EXTEND GAINS, EKRANAS CORRECTION SEEN.

text.p: Lithuanian shares extended their recent gains on Friday in brisk trade, dealers said.
Overall central market volume was over 2.2 million litas and the Litin A index rose by 46.95 points to 2,590.49.
Lithuania Gas rose to 2.36 litas from 2.31 litas and its shares remained in relatively high demand, turning over 498,786 litas.
Birzai Dairy continued to climb, rising to 11.00 litas from 10.70 litas in trade of 17,600 litas.
Dealers say that investors view Birzai as a safe bet at the moment, with low yields but low risk.
Television component producer Ekranas jumped to seven litas from 6.50 litas in trade of 372,750 litas.
"Ekranas' gains are a bit euphoric," Tomas Andrejauskas, of brokerage house Suprema, told Reuters.
"It is overvalued, rising too high, too fast," he said, adding that it could be in for a correction.
Rokishkis Cheese remained unchanged at 45.00 litas and almost 264,000 litas worth of its shares changed hands.
The company on Thursday announced that its 1996 net profit was 10.5 million litas versus 9.3 million litas the previous year.
Block trades at the session reached over 422,000 litas and low yields kept buyers away from the secondary T-bill market, which recorded no transactions.
